title: hyparrhenia luembensis
intro: Hyparrhenia luembensis, commonly known as Luembe grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in African medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hyparrhenia luembensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The plant's antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties make it useful in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions, while its expectorant properties help in relieving cough and congestion.
